description: Read recent MCP assistant tool calls: tool, time, arguments and success, not document processing history. Use for 'what did I do this week' or 'which tools has my assistant run'. Returns audit entries, default 20, max 100.

actionId.description: Optional: filter to a single tool/action name

sinceDays.description: Only show actions from the last N days (default 7)

name: get_recent_activity
